column_aliases.declared_as: Robot action, consists of [6x joint velocities, 1x gripper position].

findings.what: column 'action[:6]' is bit-identical to 'action.cartesian_position' in all 2551 frames
findings.why: documented as "Robot action, consists of [6x joint velocities, 1x gripper position]." but it holds "Commanded Cartesian position"

findings.what: commanded motion not executed for 15 frames (1.0 s): all joints static (|dq| < 1e-04 rad/frame) while the commanded joint position differs by 0.133 rad (median)
findings.why: the recorded actions do not produce the recorded next states (stuck arm, controller not engaged or stale state stream); a policy trained on these pairs learns that commands do nothing

findings.why: limits from external: Franka Emika Panda datasheet (robot_type franka_panda)

findings.what: 7 duplicated frame(s), longest run 7 (from frame 43)

findings.why: unusable for language-conditioned training; task undocumented
